SHOWER ROOMS · FIFE

Make space for a better shower.

Replacing a bath with a shower, updating an enclosure or planning a separate shower room starts with the space and plumbing you have.

Discuss your project ↗See our work

PLAN THE WORK

Comfort comes down to the details.

Consider the opening of the enclosure, the room needed to step out, and where towels and toiletries will sit. A generous-looking shower on a plan still needs to work with the door, basin and toilet.

Shower choice depends on the water supply and hot-water system. Drainage position, floor construction and waterproofing also affect what is practical. A low-profile tray or level-access layout needs to be assessed for the particular room.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Can a bath be replaced with a shower?

Often this is possible, but the water supply, drainage and available space need to be checked before agreeing a design.

Can you guarantee a level-access shower?

No layout should be promised before the floor and drainage have been assessed. Discuss the access you need when enquiring.
